C0275.title: Two Defendants Sentenced for Illegally Scraping E-Commerce Data Using Crawler Technology
keywords: illegal control of computer information systems
C0275.summary: In November 2024, Chengdu Shuangliu District People’s Court concluded a case involving crawler software used to illegally scrape e-commerce data. Zhao and Cheng developed and sold software capable of collecting newly opened online-store data and monitoring or controlling users’ computers, illegally obtaining platform data for profit. The court convicted them of illegally controlling computer information systems, sentenced them to six to eight months in prison, imposed fines, and confiscated criminal tools.
